title: Take It Easy | KEY.co
description_expanded: Take it Eeaasy offers a serene escape in the heart of the picturesque Carillon Beach community, blending luxurious comfort with breathtaking lakefront views. This custom-built, cottage-style home boasts three spacious bedrooms and four bathrooms, providing ample space for up to ten guests. Its elegant interior features hardwood floors, natural finishes, and high-end furnishings that create an inviting atmosphere perfect for unwinding. The open-concept living and dining area, with its calming coastal hues and large windows, offers a welcoming space for family gatherings, while the fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar makes meal prep a breeze. Two screened porches, one off the main floor and another off the master suite, invite guests to relax and enjoy the tranquil coastal breeze. Located just steps from the beach, Take it Eeaasy is ideally positioned within the exclusive gated community of Carillon Beach, offering a host of family-friendly amenities. Guests can enjoy tennis, basketball, and lounging by one of the three resort pools while walking paths and beautifully landscaped grounds make every stroll a relaxing experience. With nearby children’s play areas and a variety of dining options just moments away, this home provides everything needed for a perfect getaway. Whether savoring a morning coffee on the porch or exploring the local shops and restaurants, Take it Eeaasy promises an unforgettable vacation in a truly stunning setting.
